title: Safely
summary: SA'FELY, adverb 1. In a safe manner; without incurring danger or hazard of evil consequences. We may safely proceed, or safely conclude. 2. Without injury. We passed the river safely 3. Without escape

inlines.v: SA'FELY, adverb 1. In a safe manner; without incurring danger or hazard of evil consequences. We may safely proceed, or safely conclude. 2. Without injury. We passed the river safely 3. Without escape; in close custody; as, to keep a prisoner safely
